confidence.rationale: The packet’s effectiveOutcome is discrepancy_found. Reopened restaurant-issued sources independently confirm material catalog omissions and incorrect absence reconciliations. The outcome remains clear despite rejecting several Terra allergen inferences and treating inaccessible surfaces as unresolved.

confirmedFindings: Reconciliation covers all 34 baseline items: 13 exact_match/accurately_unavailable, 4 exact_match/verified, 5 exact_match/mismatch, 3 missing_from_source/accurately_unavailable, 6 missing_from_source/mismatch, 1 artifact/mismatch, 1 normalized_match/accurately_unavailable, and 1 normalized_match/verified.
The current official dinner PDF contains Chicken Pimientos and Chocolate Cake, disproving their upstream missing-from-source treatment.

The official dinner PDF contains far more food products than the 27-product worker catalog and includes a substantial drinks catalog; count_drift, current_only, non_exact_reconciliation, and parser_or_repair concerns are substantiated.

The official happy-hour surface is a distinct current service, while brunch and the full wine list remain linked from the Reston page but were not retrievable. Those inaccessible surfaces preserve uncertainty and cannot establish baseline-item absence.

No restaurant-issued allergen matrix or cross-contact policy was found. Menu descriptions support only narrow explicit positives, not complete allergen arrays, negatives, may-contain arrays, or cross-contact conclusions.

Valid narrow positives include milk for explicitly named cheeses; fish for explicitly named branzino or salmon; shellfish for shrimp/gambas; tree nut for explicitly listed almond, hazelnut, or tahini ingredients; and other allergens only when directly named by the restaurant-issued description.

Chocolate Cake is current and explicitly lists almond crumble, supporting tree-nut as a narrow positive. Its baseline wheat, gluten, and egg claims are not established by the current incomplete ingredient description.
Truffled Bikini explicitly lists fresh Mahón, supporting milk as a narrow positive. Its egg attribution is not established merely by the phrase garlic aioli.
rejectedFindings: Rejected Terra’s egg attribution for Patatas Bravas based only on garlic aioli; aioli is not sufficiently unavoidable evidence of egg.
Rejected Terra’s egg attribution for Truffled Bikini based only on garlic aioli, while retaining milk because fresh Mahón is explicitly named.
Rejected Terra’s egg-and-milk attribution for Flan Catalán as culinary inference; the current menu names the dish but does not explicitly disclose those ingredients.

Rejected any substantive cross-contact conclusion from the generic instruction to inform the server about allergies or from the raw-food warning. The deterministic cross_contact gate may remain a review sentinel, but its count is not evidence that cross-contact was disclosed.
Rejected interpreting empty allergen arrays on incompletely described products as verified negatives or complete arrays.

Rejected Terra’s broad statement that alcohol was unsupportedly excluded as necessarily an allergy-catalog error; the PDF proves omitted current presentations, but the coordinator must apply the project’s product-scope policy consistently before deciding whether all alcoholic products belong in the allergy catalog.
Rejected absence conclusions for brunch-dependent baseline items because the current brunch PDF was not retrievable.

additionalEvidence.summary: Official Reston page confirms identity and separately links Lunch & Dinner, Brunch, Full Wine List, Happy Hour, and restaurant-linked online ordering.

Current two-page Reston menu explicitly includes Chicken Pimientos, Chocolate Cake with almond crumble, Truffled Bikini with fresh Mahón and garlic aioli, numerous seafood and cheese identities, many products omitted upstream, and an extensive drinks page. It provides only a generic allergy instruction, not an allergen matrix or cross-contact policy.
Current one-page happy-hour menu confirms a separate service and additional cocktails and snacks omitted from the upstream catalog.

summary: Adjudication upholds the packet’s discrepancy_found outcome. Material current-menu omissions and two incorrect absence reconciliations are directly confirmed. Allergen evidence must be narrowed: preserve explicit named positives such as cheese/milk, shrimp/shellfish, fish identities, and almonds/tree nuts, but remove culinary assumptions, complete-array semantics, negatives, and cross-contact conclusions.
coordinatorActions: Return the result to the coordinator as discrepancy_found without marking codex_verified.
Require a fresh, complete extraction and reconciliation of every in-scope current menu surface before repair.
Keep brunch-dependent baseline items unresolved unless the current brunch source becomes accessible.
Retain only restaurant-issued explicit or unavoidable named-identity allergen positives; do not convert incomplete descriptions into complete arrays or negatives.
Review the project’s alcoholic-product scope policy before treating the drinks catalog as repairable allergy-app inventory.
Do not mutate the ledger or implement repairs from this adjudication.
